Alex —

Thanks for the CIDR list and the timing. Short answer on the webhook account: we recommend scoped read/write to the ingestion route only (POST /v1/ingest, token-limited to that path), no broad filesystem or admin scope. In the attached service-account-matrix.xlsx we included a column "recommended_endpoints" — webhook account should be limited to ingestion and eventAcknowledgement endpoints.

Operational notes:
- We will issue a short-lived client credential for the webhook account during the staging window and rotate it automatically after cutover.
- For batch exports, use a separate service account with read-only export scope and S3 write permissions to your upload bucket (scoped by prefix).

I'll add the RBAC lines to the runbook and post v1.3 by EOD.
